obernants.approximation_semantics: Mathematical relation; finite correspondence evidence only
obernants.assumptions: Successful standard allocations, terminating single-threaded calls
obernants.domain: Declared bounded API inputs, states and finite fixtures
obernants.observation_scope: Exact values, index order, state transitions and named assertions
obernants.operator: For valid closed intervals and query, any candidate result containing a non-overlap or missing an overlap is excluded; indexes must be unique and ascending. Touching endpoints are not excluded: closed intervals intersect there. Invalid/reversed query paired with Ok is excluded.

obernants.operator: A result index set S admits every interval sequence whose members overlap iff their index lies in S. Intersection positions, interval widths and exact endpoints are generally unrecoverable. Empty result admits both empty input and arbitrary disjoint intervals; no unique inverse.

obernants.operator: Overlap is !(end<query.start || query.end<start). Zero-width intervals and endpoint-touching pairs match. Changing < pruning or <= membership to strict variants loses valid outputs.
